text:
alex: quick question — how should clients detect stale pins across regions? thinking TTL alone isn't cutting it for cross-region flip scenarios.
jen: agree TTLs are weak. we should add a small opaque token to rollout metadata so control-plane and clients can quickly detect changes without full fetch.
dave: sketch: `rollout_token: "uuid-v4"`, plus a `token_visibility` flag. if public, clients can compare; if private, only control plane uses it.
lisa: product perspective: exposing tokens to clients can create coupling. clients might start building logic around token values. risk of brittle clients.
maria: maybe instead expose a `client_hint_version` integer that increments on changes. clients can use it for cheap caching checks without seeing opaque tokens.
dave: +1. combine both: opaque token for ops-level debug and client_hint_version for stable client checks. also propose `ttl_mode` enum: "finite"|"sticky"|"infinite" so we avoid magic numbers.
jen: i like explicit `ttl_mode`. also let's name the opaque field `rollout_sentinel` to avoid confusion with other tokens. document that sentinel should be treated as opaque by clients.
ops-bot: FYI schema: rollout-meta v2 deployed to staging (10.2.1.45) — automated migration will log deprecation headers for 90 days.
alex: action items: 1) update spec to include `rollout_sentinel`, `token_visibility`, `client_hint_version`, `ttl_mode`; 2) add compatibility tests; 3) ops migration checklist for dedicated/private.
jen: i'll open a follow-up PR with examples and unit tests. will add a sample client shim that only uses `client_hint_version` and ignores sentinel contents. cc @lisa for product acceptance criteria.
lisa: will review and add acceptance criteria focusing on minimizing client coupling and clear migration messaging.
maria: suggest we add a small telemetry event when sentinel changes frequently to catch thrashing.
dave: good call. also add a note in the runtime: fallback policy should prefer last-known compatible model when sentinel flips but client_hint_version unchanged.
alex: thanks all — jen please ping when PR is ready and i'll draft the ops playbook. :thumbsup:
